description: Config additions, shared claim checker, verified sources list, risk models, deterministic risk rules (NWS heat index + bands, IMD actual-max criteria via WHO India, labelled vulnerability heuristic) and the Community Risk Agent. Implements plan.md items 1-3 and decision D4/D8. Foundation for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Read d:\github work\SDK workshop\.agents\tasks\heatwise-m2\plan.md sections 'Design decisions' (D4, D8) and items 1-3 plus the Digest.

Add to backend/config.py Settings after agent_max_tool_calls: risk_vulnerability_min_indicators=2 (ge=1), planner_max_tool_calls=14, plan_max_general_advice=3, safety_llm_review=True, coordinator_max_turns=16, coordinator_max_tool_calls=10; add matching commented entries to .env.example.

Create backend/services/claims.py: extract_claims(text) for numbers with °C/°F/C/% and phrases ('clear skies', 'rain expected', 'red alert', 'orange alert', 'official warning'); check_text_claims(text, allowed_numbers, alerts_supported, tolerance=0.5) -> list[str] of problems. Tests in backend/tests/test_claims.py.

Re-fetch with web_fetch https://www.weather.gov/ama/heatindex, https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/html/heatindex_equation.shtml, https://www.who.int/india/heat-waves, https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/climate-change-heat-and-health to confirm values; create backend/guidance/__init__.py and backend/guidance/sources.py with TRUSTED_SOURCES (id, title, publisher, url, verified_on, verified_content summary) for ids nws_heat_index, wpc_heat_index_equation, who_india_heat_waves, who_heat_health_factsheet.

Create backend/models/risk.py: CommunityProfile (eight community-level boolean indicators elderly, young_children, pregnant_women, chronic_illness_group, outdoor_workers, farmers, limited_water_access, limited_shade_or_cooling; terrain plains|hilly|coastal|None; preferred_language='en'), RiskFactor, RiskAssessment (fields per plan item 2), RiskExplanation{explanation: str}.

Create backend/services/risk_rules.py: c_to_f, f_to_c, heat_index_f (WPC algorithm: simple formula averaged with T, regression + adjustments if >= 80F), nws_band, imd_indication(max_c, terrain), classify(weather, profile, min_indicators) -> RiskAssessment per D4 (score 0-4 -> low/moderate/high/very_high/extreme; unknown/insufficient_data with no weather; confidence rules; missing_data for unknown terrain, departure-from-normal unavailable, stale, demo; heuristic labelled 'project heuristic'); RULES_VERSION constant; URL comment on every threshold.
Add make_weather(temp_c, rh, fc_max, stale=False, current=True, forecast=True, data_mode='live') helper to backend/tests/fakes.py returning a WeatherIntelligenceResult.

Create backend/tests/test_risk_rules.py: NWS chart anchors 100F/55%->124 and 100F/15%->96 within 1.3F, band edges 80/90/103/125F, IMD edges 40/45/47C, hilly terrain skips the IMD rule, and >= 6 community scenarios with expected categories (see plan item 2); compute expected heat index in test via the function, assert categories.

Create backend/tools/risk_tools.py (RISK_TOOL_NAMES, build_risk_tools(get_context) with classify_heat_risk() and get_risk_rules()) and backend/agents/risk_agent.py (CommunityRiskAgent following weather_agent.py: guardrail + ledger hooks, structured_output_model=RiskExplanation, limits with structured_output_attempts=2, exceptions contained, category always from classify(), model explanation kept only if check_text_claims finds nothing and it names no other category, deterministic_explanation fallback, skip model when weather has no data, last_trace/last_blocked/as_tool()). Add 'audience', 'phase', 'revision' to _LOGGABLE_KEYS in backend/agents/hooks.py.

Create backend/tests/test_risk_agent.py with ScriptedModel: happy path, wrong category/number in explanation replaced, tool never called still categorised, unapproved tool blocked, model exception contained, no-weather path makes no model calls.
acceptance_criteria: Full offline suite passes with the original 70 tests still green
Every threshold in risk_rules.py has a URL comment that appears in TRUSTED_SOURCES, and the vulnerability adjustment is labelled as a configurable project heuristic
RiskAssessment.category is never taken from model output
verification: cd 'd:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/test_claims.py backend/tests/test_risk_rules.py backend/tests/test_risk_agent.py -q
findings:
VERIFICATION (2026-11-02): focused files -> 52 passed (test_claims 8, test_risk_rules 35, test_risk_agent 9); full offline suite -> 122 passed, 3 deselected (70 original + 52 new). No new dependencies.

SOURCES: all four pages re-fetched with web_fetch on 2026-11-02 and values confirmed; TRUSTED_SOURCES in backend/guidance/sources.py is dict[str, TrustedSource] (pydantic: id, title, publisher, url, verified_on, verified_content) keyed by id: nws_heat_index (https://www.weather.gov/ama/heatindex), wpc_heat_index_equation (https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/html/heatindex_equation.shtml), who_india_heat_waves (https://www.who.int/india/heat-waves), who_heat_health_factsheet (https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/climate-change-heat-and-health). Helper source_url(id). WHO India also states a coastal criterion (departure >= 4.5C with actual max >= 37C) - recorded in verified_content, not implemented (needs normals). WHO fact sheet page also contains public actions (shade, hydrate ~1 cup/hour, check on vulnerable people, fans only below 40C, never leave children in parked vehicles, stay informed about official warnings) usable by FEAT-002 catalog with source id who_heat_health_factsheet. No worker/farmer/emergency-number source fetched yet (FEAT-002 scope).

MODULES/NAMES: backend/services/claims.py: Claim dataclass(kind, text, value, unit 'C'|'F'|'%', negated), extract_claims(text), check_text_claims(text, allowed_numbers, alerts_supported, tolerance=0.5) -> list[str]. Sky/rain phrases are flagged even when negated; alert phrases (red/orange/yellow alert, official warning(s)/alert(s), heat wave warning) are flagged only if alerts_supported is False AND the sentence has no negation word (so the deterministic weather summary 'No official warnings are available from this provider.' passes). Unitless numbers are not claims; allowed_numbers must include °F forms if text may use them.
backend/services/risk_rules.py: RULES_VERSION='m2-risk-rules-1', CATEGORIES tuple, constants HI_CAUTION_F/HI_EXTREME_CAUTION_F/HI_DANGER_F/HI_EXTREME_DANGER_F, IMD_PLAINS_CONSIDER_C/IMD_HEAT_WAVE_C/IMD_SEVERE_HEAT_WAVE_C, URL constants NWS_HEAT_INDEX_URL/WPC_EQUATION_URL/WHO_INDIA_URL/WHO_FACTSHEET_URL, c_to_f, f_to_c, heat_index_f(t_f, rh), nws_band(hi_f)->(band|None, score), imd_indication(max_c, terrain)->'none'|'threshold_met'|'heat_wave'|'severe_heat_wave'|None (None when no value or hilly/coastal), classify(weather, profile, min_indicators=2)->RiskAssessment, rules_table()->dict (used by get_risk_rules; good for design.md rule tables). Bands: score 0 <80F, Caution 1, Extreme Caution 2, Danger 3 (103-<125), Extreme Danger 4. IMD scores: none 0, threshold_met 1, heat_wave 3, severe 4. classify accepts weather=None. RiskFactor codes: heat_index, apparent_temperature (evidence only, source_id None), forecast_max_temperature, vulnerability_heuristic (unit 'indicators'). source_ids lists only rules actually used. Wardha FakeProvider values (44.2C/21%) give HI 115.6F (Danger); with forecast 44-46 and elderly+outdoor_workers -> extreme.
backend/models/risk.py: VULNERABILITY_INDICATORS tuple, CommunityProfile (+ .indicators() -> list[str]), RiskFactor, RiskAssessment, RiskExplanation, type aliases RiskCategory, Terrain.
backend/tools/risk_tools.py: RISK_TOOL_NAMES=('classify_heat_risk','get_risk_rules'), RiskContext dataclass(weather, profile, min_indicators), build_risk_tools(get_context: Callable[[], RiskContext|None]); no-arg tools.
backend/agents/risk_agent.py: AGENT_NAME='community_risk' (trace agent name), CommunityRiskAgent(settings, model=None).run(weather, profile=None)->RiskAssessment, .as_tool() -> tool 'community_risk'(weather_json: str, profile_json: str='{}'), last_trace, last_blocked. Pure helpers: finalize_assessment(assessment, weather, explanation, records, issues), deterministic_explanation(risk), named_categories(text)->set[str], evidence_numbers(weather, risk)->set[float] (includes current/forecast values, °F of current temps, heat index C/F, factor values, and published thresholds 40/45/47C and 80/90/103/125F). Reusable by FEAT-002 safety checks. Model explanation is rejected if: classify_heat_risk not successfully called, check_text_claims problems, it names a different category, or empty.
backend/tests/fakes.py: added WARDHA ResolvedLocation and make_weather(temp_c, rh, fc_max=None, stale=False, current=True, forecast=True, data_mode='live', apparent_c=None); returns status no_data when current=False and forecast=False.
config.py: new Settings fields as specified (risk_vulnerability_min_indicators le=8, plan_max_general_advice ge=0 le=10, others le=50). hooks.py _LOGGABLE_KEYS now includes audience, phase, revision.

DEVIATIONS: (1) RiskAssessment has two extra fields not in plan item 2: explanation_source ('model'|'rules'|None) and explanation_issues: list[str] (why the model explanation was rejected or agent failure messages) - useful for the report's consistency_issues. (2) The model's explanation is additionally rejected when classify_heat_risk was never called successfully. (3) Confidence: 'low' whenever current HI inputs or forecast max is missing (plan's 'only current or only forecast'); 'medium' when both present but stale or terrain unknown. Spec files (tasks.md/design.md) not edited in this step (item 10 / later feature).
